plainText:
(Japanese: 池面大 Dai Ikemen) is a character from Pokémon Battrio: Aim to be Battrio Master!.

==History==
Dai first appeared in ABM03 where she was in a noodle restaurant. Ryū and his friends took a liking to her. Dai raced Ryū to the Battrio building where they have their match. After a long match, Dai was defeated by Ryū and Ryū celebrated by passing gas.

==Pokémon==
